description: Karnataka: Academics and parents warn of data theft, misuse, poor digital literacy, blackmailing if facial recognition is implemented in schools.
body_lead: Karnataka: Academics and parents warn of data theft, misuse, poor digital literacy, blackmailing if facial recognition is implemented in schools. A group of educationists and parents has urged Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah to withdraw the state government’s decision to introduce a facial recognition attendance system in schools. They issued a joint statement warning of the exploitation and risks associated with the use of student data.
